exposure: mixed-lipid emulsion (SMOF-LE) containing soybean oil, medium-chain triglycerides, olive oil, and fish oil
outcome: latencies of evoked peaks N2 and P2
cohort: The study included 76 preterm infants weighing less than 1000g who received either SMOF-LE or S-LE for parenteral nutrition.
finding: There was no significant difference in the latencies of N2 and P2 between the SMOF-LE and S-LE groups, although a trend toward shorter latency (faster neural conduction) was observed in the SMOF-LE group at term-equivalent age.
